description: This file contains unit tests for the BuzzShareAPI class within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It defines test cases for creating, deleting, and updating Buzz share entries, and also checks for unimplemented methods like getAll and getOne.

classes.name: BuzzShareAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzShareAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup to populate test data before any tests run.

methods.description: Tests the creation of a buzz share via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the create tests.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method, which is expected to throw a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the getAll method, expected to throw a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a buzz share via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test case data for delete tests.

methods.description: Tests the getOne method, expected to throw a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the getOne method, expected to throw a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a buzz share via the API.

methods.description: Provides test case data for update tests.
